title: Hegel's Philosophy of Mind on the paranormal

tellings.quote: more famous work by Hegel. But Hegel wrote this book philosophy of mind, which is all about, you know, the psyche. And it has extensive passages on the paranormal in it

plain: The German philosopher Hegel, best known for other works, wrote a book called Philosophy of Mind about the psyche, and it has long passages on the paranormal. The philosopher and researcher Jason Jorjani says this on the show, summarising it himself, and points to the scholar Glenn Alexander Magee, whose book Hegel and the Hermetic Tradition ties Hegel to older mystical thought. If so, one of the great names of Western philosophy took the paranormal seriously.
